skill.title: Heat held object with microwave
skill.principle: For heat-and-place tasks, after locating the target object and the microwave, take the object, go to the microwave, open it if closed, then execute `heat <object> with microwave 1` while holding the object. If the first heat attempt returns 'Nothing happens', take the object out of the microwave and retry `heat <object> with microwave 1` while holding it. Do not attempt to heat using non-microwave appliances (stoveburner, toaster, coffeemachine); these return 'Nothing happens'.
skill.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object and a microwave is available, especially if initial heat attempts fail while the object is inside or on the microwave.

skill.title: 台灯观察任务执行流程
skill.principle: 对于“examine/look at X with/under the desklamp”类任务，先定位目标物体和台灯，若目标可携带则拿起目标，移动到台灯所在位置，然后使用台灯（use desklamp <id>）完成观察。若目标物体已在台灯所在家具上，先拿起目标物体再使用台灯；若第一张桌子没有台灯，继续搜索其他承载面（sidetable、shelf、dresser）同时保持持有目标物体。
skill.when_to_apply: 当任务目标为观察某物体与台灯的关系（examine X with desklamp 或 look at X under desklamp）时。

skill.title: Clean-then-place execution loop
skill.principle: For clean-then-place goals, execute a stable loop: locate the exact target object named in the goal (do not substitute a similar object such as butterknife for knife or pan for pot), take it, go to a sinkbasin or bathtubbasin, clean it, then go to the destination receptacle, open it if closed, and put the object in/on it. If the destination already contains a similar object, still take the correct object, clean it, and place it back rather than swapping.
skill.when_to_apply: Use when the goal is to put a clean object into a specified receptacle and the object is not already clean.

skill.title: Cooling requires an open fridge and direct cool action
skill.principle: To cool an object, first go to the fridge and open it, then use the cool action with the fridge while holding the object; do not rely on putting the object into the fridge and taking it out as a substitute for cooling. A cool attempt while not co-located with an open fridge returns 'Nothing happens'.
skill.when_to_apply: When the task requires cooling an object and a fridge is available.

skill.title: 双物品放置：先取第一件并暂存，再取第二件并最终放置
skill.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，若一次只能携带一件物品，先找到并拿起第一件目标物品；若目标容器可达则直接放入最终目标容器，否则暂存到安全开放承载面，再寻找并拿起第二件目标物品，最后将两件物品都放入目标容器。优先在开放承载面（桌子、台面、架子、沙发）搜索，两件物品常在同一承载面上。
skill.when_to_apply: 当任务要求将两个同类物品放入同一目标容器，且环境限制一次只能携带一件物品时。

skill.title: 避免重复无效动作
skill.principle: 当动作返回“Nothing happens”时，不要重复同一动作；应改变状态（如打开/关闭容器、移动位置、取出物体）后再重试。若 `go to <location>` 返回“Nothing happens”，将该位置视为不可达并切换到其他候选位置；若 `open` 返回“Nothing happens”，容器可能已打开，直接继续 put。
skill.when_to_apply: 当任何动作返回“Nothing happens”且未改变环境状态时。

skill.title: 避免在未确认成功前声明完成
skill.principle: 不要输出完成状态或停止行动，直到环境观察确认最终放置动作成功；成功后立即停止，不要再发出 inventory 或空动作。若最终 put 返回“Nothing happens”，先确认已到达目标位置再重试，而不是过早声明完成或失败。
skill.when_to_apply: 在执行最终放置动作后。

skill.description: Advising the Executor to put the item into the open fridge before cooling is wrong; in successful cooling episodes the Executor holds the item, opens the fridge, and issues 'cool X with fridge' directly, keeping the item in inventory.
skill.why_it_happens: The cooling mechanic works on a held item when the agent is at an open fridge; the item does not need to be placed inside and retrieved.
skill.how_to_avoid: Advise: go to fridge, open fridge, cool the held item directly, then go to the destination and put it there. Do not instruct put-into-fridge-then-take.

skill.title: Cool held item at an open fridge, then go straight to destination
skill.principle: To cool an item, hold it, navigate to the fridge, open the fridge, and issue the cool command on the held item; after a confirmed cool, go directly to the destination receptacle and put the item there without retrieving it from the fridge.
skill.when_to_apply: When the goal requires a cooled item and the agent is holding the target object.

skill.description: Heating an object directly from inventory fails with 'Nothing happens'; success requires putting the object into the open microwave, then heating. The Critic must not declare the object heated while it is merely held.
skill.why_it_happens: The heating action requires the target object to be inside the microwave, not in the agent's inventory; the Critic may misread a failed heat as success.
skill.how_to_avoid: Advise: go to microwave, open it, put the object inside, then heat. Verify the observation text before declaring success; do not claim an item was heated while in inventory.

skill.description: Recommending unsupported heating appliances such as stoveburners or toasters after a microwave failure leads to 'Nothing happens'; the reliable path is the open microwave with put-then-heat.
skill.why_it_happens: The environment may not support heating on stoveburners or toasters for the target object, and occupied stoveburners cannot accept another object.
skill.how_to_avoid: Do not advise stoveburner or toaster heating as a recovery. Direct the Executor back to the open microwave: put the object inside, then heat.

skill.description: If 'use desklamp' returns 'Nothing happens', the agent is likely not at the desklamp's location; the Critic should advise verifying position and navigating to the desklamp before retrying, rather than repeating the same command.
skill.why_it_happens: The use action requires the agent to be co-located with the desklamp; issuing it from elsewhere produces no state change.
skill.how_to_avoid: After a failed use desklamp, advise checking current location and moving to the desklamp, then using it. Do not repeat the same command from the same spot.

skill.description: If an action returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat the same invalid command; verify the current location and choose a valid reachable receptacle or action instead. This applies to moves, opens, takes, and examines alike.
skill.why_it_happens: The agent may issue commands for locations or objects that are not currently accessible or valid, or use a bare object name instead of the exact identifier, causing no state change.
skill.how_to_avoid: After a 'Nothing happens' observation, re-check the current location and available objects, confirm exact object identifiers from the observation, then select a different valid action rather than retrying the same command.

skill.description: Several failed or budget-exhausted episodes show the Executor repeatedly moving to invalid or already-searched locations, or arriving at closed receptacles without opening them. This wastes steps and prevents finding the target object.
skill.why_it_happens: The environment may return 'Nothing happens' for invalid moves, and the Executor may loop on the same location or command without updating its search strategy.
skill.how_to_avoid: Track visited receptacles and their contents. If a move returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat it; verify the current location and choose a different unsearched receptacle. Open closed receptacles before checking them. Prioritize likely object locations based on object type.

skill.description: In dual-item placement, attempting to take the second item while already holding the first returns 'Nothing happens'; the Critic should advise placing the held item in the destination first to free the hands.
skill.why_it_happens: The agent can typically hold only one item at a time, so a take while holding fails.
skill.how_to_avoid: Before advising the take of the second item, direct the Executor to put the first item into the destination receptacle, then return for the second.

skill.description: In dual-item placement, issuing a put action before arriving at the destination receptacle returns 'Nothing happens'; the Critic should confirm arrival before advising put.
skill.why_it_happens: The put action requires the agent to be co-located with the target container; putting from a distance cannot take effect.
skill.how_to_avoid: Before advising put, confirm the Executor has navigated to the destination receptacle; if a put fails, advise moving to the destination and retrying there.

skill.description: Cleaning attempts can fail with 'Nothing happens' when the Executor is not at a valid sinkbasin or is not holding the object. The Critic should advise verifying both conditions before retrying, and try a different sinkbasin if needed.
skill.why_it_happens: The clean action requires the agent to be at a valid cleaning receptacle, typically a sinkbasin, while holding the object; some receptacles do not support cleaning for certain objects.
skill.how_to_avoid: Advise: hold the object, go to a sinkbasin, then clean. If cleaning returns 'Nothing happens', verify the current location and try a different sinkbasin. Do not repeatedly attempt the same invalid clean action.
